findings.finding: Main-branch workflow schedules hourly, reads GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN, queries Gumroad sales, hashes subscriber email addresses with unsalted SHA-256, writes web/subscribers.json, and commits/pushes main.
findings.risk: Low-entropy email addresses can be dictionary-matched against unsalted hashes. Pseudonymized data may remain linkable.
limitations: No plaintext email disclosure was established.
No current Gumroad token was read or used.
findings.proposal: Disable schedule and job, set permissions empty, remove secret reference and all API/write commands pending privacy review.

findings.finding: Main-branch workflow schedules a daily public issue using issues:write and scripts/daily_digest.py.
findings.risk: Publicly publishing an unvalidated historical accuracy claim.
evidence: Public issue #1538 contains the legacy 45.5% accuracy claim over 1,697 signals while also reporting confidence 0.0, missing provider credentials and a Groq 429.
limitations: The issue was not edited or closed.
The underlying accuracy statistic is not validated from reproducible row-level outcomes.
findings.proposal: Disable schedule and job, remove write permission and credential access until fixed-horizon evaluation status is accurate.

findings.finding: Main-branch workflow schedules scripts/resolve_issue.py --all with issues:write.
findings.risk: Batch comments/closures can be applied without per-issue human authorization.
evidence: Earlier observed run closed issues #1545, #1514 and #1492 without per-issue approval.
limitations: No new issue mutation was executed in this run.
findings.proposal: Disable schedule and job pending per-issue authorization, auditable evidence and protected approval.

findings.finding: Main-branch hourly workflow has issues:write and pull-requests:write; it scans failed workflow runs and creates issues/assignments.
findings.root_cause: The implementation comment claimed a 24-hour scan, but the gh run list command used --status failure --limit 100 without a createdAt cutoff or default-branch/event filter.
evidence: An earlier main run created issues #1574–#1579 for failed PR-branch validation runs that had zero jobs and failed before execution; the corrected PR head later passed.
limitations: No issue was created or assigned in this run.
findings.proposal: Disable hourly workflow pending a time-bounded, default-branch/event-filtered scanner, duplicate/rate-limit controls and protected approval.

findings.finding: Main-branch workflow runs every six hours with issues:write and executes scripts/self_schedule.py, which can create and label source-gap issues.
evidence: Earlier observed run found no new gaps and created no issue.
limitations: A prior no-op does not remove future write capability.
findings.proposal: Disable schedule and job until deduplication, issue limits and downstream task-trigger authorization are reviewed.

regression_tests.ci_registration: tests/test_v3_scripts.py is already included in the repository's core CI test command; no CI workflow change was required.

limitations: The existing public web/subscribers.json file was not inspected; its metadata was previously 26 bytes.
Unsalted SHA-256 does not anonymize email addresses against dictionary attacks.
Quarantining workflows on a PR branch does not disable them on main; approval and merge are still required.
No secret values were accessed; no external API calls, issue closures, assignments, deployments or commits to main were executed.
next_actions: Obtain approval before merging PR #1584; all five workflows remain active on main until then.
Review public issue #1538 and correct/remove the unvalidated accuracy claim through authorized action.
Inspect subscriber file contents only after explicit privacy review/authorization; do not reproduce subscriber identifiers in research artifacts.
Replace unsalted email hashes with an approved privacy-preserving design and non-public storage if subscriber analytics remain required.
Add a bounded default-branch-only resolver scan with per-issue authorization and duplicate/rate-limit controls before re-enabling.
Continue main branch protection and required-check enforcement audit.
